title: Isobaric Interference Corrections Applied
description: Whether isobaric interference corrections were applied for any measured isotope in this protocol. A protocol-level Boolean: if the protocol includes interference corrections, this is always Yes. Element-specific detail is captured in Interfering Species and Interference Correction Method.
